sentences.text: The petitioner alleges violation of the order dated 15.03.2022, vide which Land Acquisition Collector, GMADA, SAS Nagar, as per judgment dated 16.09.2016 passed by the Reference Court/Addl. District Judge, has directed to determine the amount of compensation and the same was re- determined.
Admittedly, judgment passed by the Addl. District Judge, under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, is executable.
Faced with the above, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition with liberty to the petitioner to avail the alternative remedy, in accordance with law.
Dismissed as withdrawn with liberty aforesaid.

Arvind Singh Sangwan, J. (Oral)
The petitioner alleges violation of the order dated 15.03.2022, vide which Land Acquisition Collector, GMADA, SAS Nagar, as per judgment dated 16.09.2016 passed by the Reference Court/Addl. District Judge, has directed to determine the amount of compensation and the same was re- determined.
Admittedly, judgment passed by the Addl. District Judge, under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, is executable.
